renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Take the letter with its out-breath and end in knowing — with a supportless mind, touch the forever-real. Picture your own self as sky-formed, directions uncovered all around — by supportless knowing-power, your own form shows itself then.

Pierce one limb first — a needle-point — and yoke your knowing right there: the going is spotless, into Bhairava. Say it flat: the in-me-making is not in me — fancies have nowhere to stand, so they drop off.

Her trick is counting: she numbers the real things and calls that delusion — yet counted things never stand apart. Watch a sudden want rise, then walk it to calm — where it rose, right there it melts.

When no want of mine has risen — knowing or not, why not — then I am: in truth He-I, melted, of that mind. Set the mind in a risen want or a risen knowing — self-mind undivided: then the meaning of the real is seen.

Knowing can stand with no cause, propless, wrong-shaped — and it is no one's, not-this: so turn Śiva, dear one. Knowing-natured, all bodies, no split anywhere — made of that, picturing all: world-winner.

First pierce one limb — needle-point — and leash your knowing to that spot: clean entry, Bhairava-bound. Flat statement: the in-me factory is not in me — fancies lose their footing and fall off.
Her con is counting: she numbers real things and calls it delusion — but counted things never stand solo. Clock a sudden craving, escort it to calm — born there, dissolved there.

Zero wants of mine online — knowing or otherwise, whatever — then I am: actually He-I, melted, that-minded. Plant the mind in a live want or a live knowing — self-mind single: then the real's meaning gets seen.
Knowing can run causeless, propless, glitch-shaped — nobody's not-this: so go Śiva, dear one. Knowing-natured, every body, zero splits — built of that, picturing all: world-champ.
